title: Learning to Search for Executable Patternmaking from Certified Programs
abstract: arXiv:2610.21579v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recent models generate sewing patterns from images or text, and program-based representations make these patterns executable. These systems produce a finished pattern and do not model how a patternmaker turns one pattern into another. In practice a new style is made by editing an existing pattern: lengthening the bodice, moving a dart, swapping a sleeve. Pattern archives record the results of such edits and none of the steps. We observe that the steps can be recovered by searching over editing actions until one pattern becomes the other. A deterministic compiler makes the recovered steps checkable. To this end, we present SemDraft, the first framework that learns to search for executable patternmaking programs from paired before-and-after sewing patterns without recorded editing steps. translated_title: 从经认证的程序中学习搜索可执行的服装打版方法
translated_abstract: 最近的模型可以从图像或文本生成服装纸样，而基于程序的表示使这些纸样变得可执行。然而这些系统只能产出最终完成的纸样，并未建模制版师如何将一个纸样转化为另一个纸样。在实践中，新款式是通过编辑现有纸样来制作的：加长衣身、移动省道、更换袖子等。纸样档案只记录了这些编辑的结果，却没有记录任何编辑步骤。我们观察到，通过对编辑动作进行搜索，直到一个纸样变成另一个纸样，便可以恢复出这些编辑步骤；而一个确定性编译器使恢复出的步骤可以被验证。为此，我们提出了 SemDraft，这是首个能够从成对的“编辑前-编辑后”缝纫纸样中学习搜索可执行打版程序的框架，且无需记录的编辑步骤。具体而言，有界搜索会恢复出一个由编辑动作构成的程序，并只有在通过三项检查后才对其进行认证：该程序可以从头重新编译，每一对……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出 SemDraft——首个无需记录编辑步骤、通过有界搜索并结合确定性编译器的三项认证检查，从成对的前后缝纫纸样中学习恢复可执行服装打版编辑程序的框架。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces SemDraft, the first framework that learns to search for executable patternmaking programs from paired before-and-after sewing patterns—without recorded editing steps—by using bounded search and certifying recovered programs through checks with a deterministic compiler.
